title: Toboggan Trajectory
description: Count trees hit while sliding down a repeating grid at various slopes.
writeup:
## Approach

The grid repeats horizontally, so use modulo arithmetic on the x-coordinate. Count trees for each slope independently.

## Part 1

Slide down the grid with slope (3, 1) — move right 3, down 1 each step. Count cells containing `#`. The grid wraps using `x % width`.

## Part 2

Repeat for five slopes: (1,1), (3,1), (5,1), (7,1), (1,2). Multiply all tree counts together.
